question: On which bodily locus must the path of worlds in its essential form be placed?
premises: The path of worlds in meaning-form is the object.
The head is the specified locus.
The placement is prescribed as a ritual act.
inference: The officiant should place the path of worlds in its essential form on the head.
plain_english: He should place the path of worlds, in its essential form, on the head as well.
